findings.title: Legal temporary equipment Leviathans block checkpoint validation
findings.fix: Accept only friendly temporary non-Heroic Leviathans with matching plague/behemoth advancedBodies and independent, cannotGrow, cannotRevive member provenance.

findings.title: Fixed-lifespan death is swallowed by shields and damage reductions

reproduced.case: real module.behemoth.5 elite ultralisk with defensive boost
S15 ordinary marine with teammate entry barrier

findings.cause: Expiry used hit(current HP + armor + 1, forced=true); forced damage still pays native shields/barriers and defenses. S15 deadline was cleared even if the packet did not kill.
findings.fix: Direct expiry enters the existing guarded death commit once, retains native death hooks/explosion, skips equipment death revival as before; lifespan checks precede unit AI/elite early returns. Other forced attacks and ordinary incoming damage are unchanged.
additionalCoverage: Temporary mercenary roach expires during burrow transition
No duplicate death event or advanced explosion
No equipment revival receipt on expiry

findings.title: S15 units can receive forbidden health and native shield recovery

reproduced.case: allied Artanis reconstruction heals S15 stalker shield
real reinforcement landing heals S15 marine

findings.fix: Central recovery qualification blocks S15 in the existing recovery factor and medical/automatic queen target selection; explicit fixed healing paths (reinforcement landing, sustain set, shield-break restoration, repair fort) use the same qualification. No healing amount, duration or equipment stat is changed.

findings.trigger: 浏览器不可用localStorage，或撤回队列写入抛错；曾明确同意统计后撤回或删除
findings.before: withdraw只将请求写入可选存储；retryPrivacy再读不到请求，完全不请求服务端，却没有pendingPrivacy
findings.after: 仅存储失败的撤回请求保存在本页内存中，实际调用既有接口；网络失败保留待重试，删除意图不被降级，未完成前不能再次授权
findings.limitations: 若浏览器完全不能保存且页面关闭，内存中的待发送请求无法跨重启保留；已有磁盘/多页权威路径保持。
